_comment: Service reachability checks for the Office apps feature (network/office_services.py). Adding a service needs only a new entry in 'services'. Hosts may contain {tenant}; such checks are skipped when no tenant is given. 'optimize' marks traffic Microsoft puts in the Optimize category (must bypass proxy/VPN). 'verified': false means no public target could be confirmed to answer this probe; the check is reported as untested instead of failed. Each check cites its source in 'source'.

checks.name: Sign-in service (Entra ID)
checks.source: urls-and-ip-address-ranges: endpoint set 56 (Allow, Required); public OpenID metadata, no credentials

checks.name: Exchange Online (Outlook) secure connection
checks.source: urls-and-ip-address-ranges: endpoint set 1 (Optimize, Required), TCP 443/80, UDP 443

checks.name: SharePoint Online front door
checks.source: urls-and-ip-address-ranges: endpoint set 31 *.sharepoint.com (Optimize, Required); TLS handshake only, no HTTP request

services.name: Microsoft Teams
services.targets_source: Client to Microsoft network edge: RTT < 100 ms, packet loss < 1% during any 15 s, inter-arrival jitter < 30 ms during any 15 s (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/plan-optimize-network-performance-for-teams-phone-system/2-understand-teams-network-requirements)

checks.name: Teams service
checks.source: urls-and-ip-address-ranges: endpoint set 12 (Allow, Required), TCP 443/80, UDP 443

checks.name: Teams media relay (UDP 3478)
checks.source: urls-and-ip-address-ranges: endpoint set 11 (Optimize, Required) 52.112.0.0/14, 52.122.0.0/15, UDP 3478-3481. The host is under *.teams.microsoft.com, resolves into 52.112.0.0/14 and answered a STUN Binding Request when probed; the host name itself is not listed on the page.

checks.name: Teams media relay TCP fallback (443)
checks.source: urls-and-ip-address-ranges: endpoint set 12 covers 52.112.0.0/14 on TCP 443 (Teams falls back to TCP when UDP is blocked)

checks.name: Zoom name lookup
checks.source: Zoom firewall rules: allow zoom.us and *.zoom.us

checks.name: Zoom meeting port TCP 8801
checks.source: Zoom firewall rules: TCP 443, 8801, 8802. Not verifiable: zoom.us accepts TCP connections on any port (22, 8801 and 8899 all connected when probed), so a connect proves nothing about meeting servers.

checks.name: Zoom media UDP 8801
checks.source: Zoom firewall rules: UDP 3478, 3479, 8801-8810. No public Zoom host answered a STUN Binding Request on UDP 3478 or 8801 when probed.

m365_fallback._comment: Optimize endpoint sets copied from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/urls-and-ip-address-ranges (last updated 10/30/2026); used only when the web service and the cache are both unavailable.
